title: Sextuple
summary: SEX'TUPLE, adjective [Low Latin sextuplus; sex, six, and duplus, double.] 1. Sixfold; six times as much. 2. In music, denoting a mixed sort of triple, beaten in double time, or a measure of two times

inlines.v: SEX'TUPLE, adjective [Low Latin sextuplus; sex, six, and duplus, double.] 1. Sixfold; six times as much. 2. In music, denoting a mixed sort of triple, beaten in double time, or a measure of two times composed of six equal notes, three for each time.
